author: Anthony Mitchell
title: Northwestern football preps for Week 0 road battle against FCS Division I Western Illinois - NewsBreak
text:
By Anthony Mitchell ,
1 days ago
ORANGE CITY, Iowa (KCAU) - The college football season is on the horizon as many local teams are hitting the road for big tests to start the season, including a Northwestern squad that is facing off against a Division I opponent to begin the 2026 campaign.
The Red Raiders will battle a Division I FCS opponent for the first time since the program's overtime win against Drake in 2023. The two programs are meeting for the first time-ever.
Northwestern returns six All-GPAC players, including quarterback Colby Duncan and defensive back Kylar Fritz.
NWC was picked third in the preseason coaches poll and recognize the opportunities that come with the early season slate.
"For this group, I think it's just competing every single day. tHis a group that has tasted some success. I think last year there's some disappointment in last season, but they also realize how close they were and how important all the details are, and I think it was a great reminder for them last year," Northwestern head coach Matt McCarty said. "The work that they're putting in just a focused work every single day that's really been our focus, trying to keep it as simple as possible and as focused as possible."
Northwestern takes on the Leathernecks on Thursday night at 6 p.m.
